messages.text:
Small workspace quirk: there’s no Bash here, so I’m adjusting `compile.sh` to be directly usable by the Windows runtime in this benchmark.

The generated entrypoint will still be the required Python-backed `executable.cmd`, and no higher-priority `executable` file will be left behind.
